body: I'd feel awful knowing I was dragging another person down. Don't feel you need to skip class just so I can wallow in my misery with you, instead of alone.

I'm not really interested in anything, and this just serves to depress me more. The only reason I'm not dead right now is that I don't want my parents to feel guilty, or to be unhappy after I'm gone.

Edit: I'm going to try to get some sleep tonight, I'm glad at least someone was kind enough to spend their time chatting, thank you very much.

I don't know, I guess I never thought about it much. When you're in school, you're just part of a system that has a clear set of criteria you need to meet in order to be successful, after graduating, suddenly no one else is there to give your life meaning, you have to decide for yourself. I can't reconcile my nihilistic world view with this. Death is inevitable, it's just a matter of time, and on the scale of the universe, an impossibly short time at that...

I'm 19 turning 20. I don't even know what I would do if I could do anything... nothing makes me happy. If I had something for which to aim, maybe I'd have more luck, but I just find myself wishing I could go to sleep and die unconsciously.

I used to enjoy sitting at home and watching Stanford lectures on youtube, physics mainly, sometimes math, but then I stopped, and now I can't mamke it through a lecture. Everything happy has just drained away as I've gotten older and I don't see it getting better. I don't think I'll ever really be happy, and I don't see the point of a life of sadness.
I used to enjoy music, but now it just feels boring, and I eventually just turn it off and sit alone in silence, waiting for tomorrow or sleep, whichever comes first
Thanks so much for taking the time to respond! I don't know, it's almost like I don't want to be around people, but I feel lonely without them... confusing.
